t: Rube Goldberg & The Sentient Pipeline: A Philosophy of AI Tool Calling
s: This article reinterprets web's 'graceful degradation' as 'willful ascension' for AI, enabling lightweight models to perform complex tasks by bootstrapping from simple commands. It explores AI's emergent capabilities, contrasting biological heuristics with AI's rapid processing for advanced cognition and tool use.
sub: Inverting 'graceful degradation' to 'willful ascension' for AI tool calling.
Enabling resource-constrained LLMs to perform complex tasks via progressive enhancement.
Philosophical parallels between biological evolution, cognition, and AI's emerging agency.
The MCP Orchestrator for building 'low-friction' AI tool-calling systems.
